title: Patch: the card creator's unsaved-draft guard covers every way off the page

**Issue #1754 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1754: Patch: the card creator's unsaved-draft guard covers every way off the page
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

If you are building a custom card and have unsaved work, the page already warns you before a reload or when you press its own Back button — but every other way off the page throws the draft away silently. A queue popping into a found match, accepting a friend's challenge toast, or the browser's Back button all leave the creator with no prompt and the draft gone. After this change each of those exits raises the same "discard draft?" prompt.

## Why

A draft lives only in the page, and the guard covers exactly two exits: `beforeunload` for reload/tab-close and the `BackLink`'s `onPress` raising `UnsavedNote` (`apps/web/src/routes/creator.tsx:33-56`, per R668/R1484000). Every other exit bypasses it: `useQueueFollow` auto-navigates any non-`/play` screen to a found match after `MATCH_FOUND_NAV_DELAY_MS` (`apps/web/src/net/liveGame.ts:245-254`) — queue on `/play`, open `/creator`, edit a card, match found → draft gone with no prompt; `ChallengeToast.accept` calls `navigate(target)` directly (`apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.tsx:135-142`); and `popstate` swaps the route in `usePathname` with no confirmation (`apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts:37-48`).

## Proposal

A route-level dirty guard the creator registers while `unsaved` holds, consulted by `navigate()` (covering the queue's deferred navigation and the challenge toast) and by the `popstate` path, raising the same `UnsavedNote` affordance — navigate on confirm, stay on keep.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/routes/creator.tsx`, `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts` or a small guard module beside it, `apps/web/src/net/liveGame.ts`, `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.tsx`; tests beside `navigate`/`creator`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Queue-found navigation, a challenge accept and browser Back each raise the draft prompt instead of silently navigating
- [ ] A clean creator (nothing unsaved) navigates freely on every path
- [ ] The existing reload and BackLink prompts are unchanged
- [ ] The deferred queue navigation can be cancelled without leaving the queue in a stuck state

## Size and risks

Medium — it touches shared navigation, so the design must avoid double-prompting (a BackLink press plus a popstate) and must let a cancelled queue navigation be re-offered. The draft itself is unchanged; no server or engine work.
```
